summary: Elme Communities filed an 8-K reporting completion of the sale of Elme Bethesda, a 193-unit community in Bethesda, Maryland, to Tilden Bethesda Hill Apartments, LLC (assignee of CAPREIT Acquisition Corporation) for $58.0 million, subject to customary prorations. The sale closed on August 11, 2026, following Montgomery County right-of-first-refusal compliance and amendments to the original May 27, 2026 purchase agreement. Pro forma financials reflect liquidation basis statements, indicating ongoing dispositions. Watch for further asset sales and progress toward full liquidation or strategic repositioning.
